blocks.heading: Government Science-Sector Jobs Worth Checking
rows: ICAR (agriculture and allied life sciences)

ICAR's JRF route, run through the Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board (ASRB) and the AIEEA-PG entrance, is built primarily for BSc Agriculture graduates and pays a stipend of roughly ₹31,000/month (JRF) or ₹35,000/month (SRF) toward a funded MSc or PhD at an ICAR institute or state agricultural university. If your BSc is in Botany, Zoology, or a related allied-science subject rather than Agriculture, verify the current year's eligible-subject list before assuming direct entry.
DRDO (CEPTAM Senior Technical Assistant-B)

DRDO's CEPTAM exam accepts a Bachelor's degree in Science for the STA-B post, commonly listing Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science among eligible subjects. The age band is typically 18-28. Life-science subjects are not always on every year's list, so check the specific vacancy notification before preparing.
CSIR national laboratories (Technical Assistant)

Eligibility is institute-specific and often stricter than people expect. CSIR-CBRI and CSIR-IHBT lean toward Chemistry, Physics, or Geology, also with 60%+ and prior lab experience. A fresh BSc graduate without any lab experience often cannot apply directly, a contractual project-assistant stint first is a common real-world route in.
Forensic science laboratories

State-level recruitment is the realistic BSc-level entry point, Uttar Pradesh's UPSSSC, for example, has recruited for around 208 Scientific and Lab Assistant posts open to BSc graduates in Chemistry, Biology, or Physics, with an age band roughly 21-40. Central and metro forensic labs (such as Delhi's FSL) more often ask for a master's degree, or Chemistry carried as a subject through all three years of the BSc, for their Junior Scientific Assistant and Scientific Officer grades.
State Pollution Control Boards (environmental testing)

Junior Lab Assistant and Scientific Assistant posts commonly accept a BSc in Science or Environmental Science, though the exact bar varies by state, some boards list "BSc, MSc" as acceptable qualifications rather than BSc alone, so a specific state's current notification is the only reliable source.

blocks.heading: PCB Students Is a Different Question

items.text: You already finished the degree decision three or four years ago.
You now hold an actual BSc, in Biology, Botany, Zoology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or Microbiology, with real subject depth.
Your options today are shaped by your marks, your subject, your college, and how much runway you have left before you need income.
The question is no longer "what should I study", it is "what do I do with what I already studied."

blocks.heading: Track: NET, JRF, and Phd, Explained Honestly

items.text: CSIR-NET lets a candidate with a BSc (Hons) or equivalent and at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwD) apply, but only for the Junior Research Fellowship, not for Lectureship or Assistant Professor eligibility.
To actually draw the JRF fellowship, you must register for a PhD or Integrated PhD programme within the validity window after qualifying, clearing the exam alone does not pay you.
UGC-NET, by contrast, requires a completed master's degree.

This route carries competition at two separate stages, not one: qualifying CSIR-NET is the first hurdle, and a genuinely funded PhD seat, followed later by a permanent scientist-cadre or faculty post, is a separate and harder climb, clearing the first entry requirement does not guarantee the second.

blocks.heading: B.ed, MBA, and Certification-Based Bridge Routes

items.text: A standard B.Ed is a 2-year, NCTE-recognised programme open to any BSc graduate; a few universities now run 4-year integrated BSc-B.Ed tracks under NEP 2020.
A B.Ed alone does not make you employable, you also need to clear CTET or the relevant state TET, and most schools want your science subject specialisation for classes 6-12.
This route fits a genuine interest in teaching and explaining science, not a fallback for students who could not decide on anything else.

blocks.heading: Step-By-Step Decision Sprint If You Are Stuck

items.text: Run the four questions on each shortlisted direction.
Complete one proof task for your top two options.
Verify current eligibility and vacancy details on official sources.
Get one outside opinion and eliminate one option.
